creative_directions.name: Lamp-lit paper diorama
creative_directions.concept: TODO: the storyteller opens a kaavad box; the world is laid out in deckle-edged paper under a flickering lamp; the god rises into a prabhavali; blossoms fall at the turn.

visual_identity.palette: Rag paper, lamp-black ink, sindoor, lapis, malachite and gold leaf
visual_identity.typography: Playfair Display titles, EB Garamond text
visual_identity.texture: Paper fibre, deckle edges, duotoned museum plates

motion_language.transitions: Kaavad doors, lamp carried, dissolve under the lamp

composition.approach: Portrait: source cartouche top, sacred figure on the upper-middle third inside an arch, captions low.

creative_directions.pacing: Measured: an event every 2-3 s, breathing holds on the sacred figure

creative_directions.name: Shadow theatre
creative_directions.concept: TODO: the episode performed by jointed leather puppets against a lamp-lit screen (shadow-lantern style); best for battles and journeys.

composition.approach: Figures in profile on one ground line; the lamp marks the scene that matters.

creative_directions.pacing: Performative; poses change on the spoken verb

creative_directions.name: Painted folio or museum relief
creative_directions.concept: TODO: the tradition's own art carries the film: a folio border and register strips (painted-folio) or duotoned museum objects in 2.5D (carved-relief).

visual_identity.palette: Ivory folio, folio red, lapis, gold

composition.approach: Registers read in the tradition's order; one plate dominant.

success_criteria: The viewer can name the text, the figure and the turn
No sacred image is shown at foot level, destroyed or mocked
Every image credited on screen or in the end card
The ending returns to the opening lamp and holds for at least 2 seconds
